theorem optimized_event_budget (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p) :
    eventLimit (optimizedRaw (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)) ≤ p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2) := by sorry

theorem simple_event_budget (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p) :
    eventLimit (simpleRaw (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)) ≤ p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2) := by sorry

theorem literal_time_bound (p : Family) (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n)
    (hS : 0 < p.S) (hSm : p.S ≤ p.m) (hρ : 0 < p.ρ) (hρone : p.ρ ≤ 1)
    (hL : 0 ≤ p.Lminus) (hD : 0 ≤ p.Lpm) (hΔ : 0 ≤ p.Δ) (hε : 0 < p.ε)
    (hlarge : largeSample p.m p.n) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (τ : Fin p.n → ℝ≥0∞) (hmono : Monotone τ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hservice : PrimitiveService f τ O)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : eventLimit (familyRaw p false) ≤ N) :
    let q := familyRaw p false
    let P := (executionLaw q O : Measure (Seed q.K × ((a : ℕ) → O.Seed a)))
    (∫⁻ z, ((execute O (factory q) (fun _ => N) z.1 z.2).2 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂P) ≤
      10 * equilibriumTime τ p.m +
        ENNReal.ofReal (10 * p.Δ * familyCoefficient p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ / p.ε) *
          (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ * equilibriumTime τ p.m +
            ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p.ρ) * equilibriumTime τ p.S) := by sorry

theorem optimized_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    let A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)
    let P := (A.law : Measure A.Seed).prod (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k))
    let out := fun z : A.Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
      execute O A (fun _ => p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2
    Integrable (fun z => ‖gradient (objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2) P ∧
      (∫ z, ‖gradient (objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤ p.ε := by sorry

theorem optimized_time (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    let A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)
    let P := (A.law : Measure A.Seed).prod (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k))
    let out := fun z : A.Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
      execute O A (fun _ => p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2
    (∫⁻ z, ((out z).2 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂P) ≤ 12 * (equilibriumTime p.τ (p.m : ℝ≥0∞)) + ENNReal.ofReal (96 * p.Δ / p.ε) * (⨅ S : Fin p.m, min (ENNReal.ofReal p.Lminus * (equilibriumTime p.τ (p.m : ℝ≥0∞))) (ENNReal.ofReal p.Lminus * equilibriumTime p.τ (S.val + 1) + ENNReal.ofReal p.Lpm * (((equilibriumTime p.τ (p.m : ℝ≥0∞)) * equilibriumTime p.τ (S.val + 1) / (S.val + 1)) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ))))) := by sorry

theorem simple_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    let A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)
    let P := (A.law : Measure A.Seed).prod (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k))
    let out := fun z : A.Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
      execute O A (fun _ => p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2
    Integrable (fun z => ‖gradient (objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2) P ∧
      (∫ z, ‖gradient (objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤ p.ε := by sorry

theorem simple_time (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    let A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)
    let P := (A.law : Measure A.Seed).prod (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k))
    let out := fun z : A.Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
      execute O A (fun _ => p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2
    (∫⁻ z, ((out z).2 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂P) ≤ 12 * (equilibriumTime p.τ (p.m : ℝ≥0∞)) + ENNReal.ofReal (192 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε) * (equilibriumTime p.τ (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt p.m))) := by sorry

theorem optimized_factory (p : Optimized) :
    (p.Δ = 0 ∨ p.Lminus = 0 → optimized p = constantPoint none (p.x0, 0)) ∧
      (p.Δ ≠ 0 → p.Lminus ≠ 0 → optimized p = literal (optimizedRaw p)) ∧
      (equilibriumTime p.τ p.m = 0 ∨ equilibriumTime p.τ p.m = ⊤ →
        optimizedProbability p = 1) ∧
      (optimizedRaw p).S = optimizedBatch p ∧
      (optimizedRaw p).ρ = optimizedProbability p ∧
      (optimizedRaw p).η = optimizedStep p ∧
      (optimizedRaw p).K = optimizedHorizon p := by sorry

noncomputable def normalizedInput (p : Simple) (τ : Fin p.n → ℝ≥0∞) : Optimized where
  d := p.d
  m := p.m
  n := p.n
  x0 := p.x0
  Δ := p.Δ
  ε := p.ε
  Lminus := max p.Lminus p.Lpm
  Lpm := max p.Lminus p.Lpm
  τ := τ

theorem normalized_optimality (p : Simple) (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n)
    (hL : 0 ≤ p.Lminus) (hD : 0 ≤ p.Lpm) (hM : 0 < max p.Lminus p.Lpm)
    (hnm : (p.n : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt p.m) (τ : Fin p.n → ℝ≥0∞) (hmono : Monotone τ) :
    ∀ S : ℕ, 0 < S → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 →
      timeCoefficient (normalizedInput p τ) (simpleBatch p) (simpleProbability p) ≤
        20 * timeCoefficient (normalizedInput p τ) S ρ := by sorry

theorem optimized_execution_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.successful p f
      (fun z : (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)) (fun _ => p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)).law : Measure (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p)).Seed).prod
        (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k)), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem simple_execution_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.successful p f
      (fun z : (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)) (fun _ => p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)).law : Measure (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p)).Seed).prod
        (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k)), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry
